set.body:
Purpose and scope
Extend the versioned MRI view compiler and supported readiness contract to include the complete qualified family, inherited metadata and rewritten target references. Preserve image bytes and exact transformation receipts. Keep unsupported family forms explicit. Required scientific fields cannot disappear through disclosure masks.

Acceptance proof
Shared catalog cases select a BOLD target with a cross-session family, export/re-import the view and compare family membership, effective metadata and rewritten references. Missing companions and masked required fields block preparation. Excluded targets are not disclosed; all output files have receipts; existing profile identities remain readable.

Start here
modules/bids/src/main/scala/sanctity/bids/{MriViewCompiler,MriInputPlanner}.scala; modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/{ScientificViews,ProcessingInputs}.scala; modules/app/src/test/scala/sanctity/app/SubsetSuite.scala

Working agreement
Preserve the existing working-tree baseline. Use current repository contracts, keep historical identities stable, and attach actual verification commands/results before closing. Coordinate shared catalog files, profile versions and migration numbers with other work in this tranche. Planning references: docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md.
set.title: F3: Materialize coherent phase1/phase2 views and processing bundles
